detail.longDescription: Hello HN! As someone who would have otherwise never got into game development if it wasn't for AI, I'm really sorry to see how many peoples' creations get immediately overlooked because it's "AI slop." Slop or not, many people have very interesting and/or original concepts, and regardless of the means of production I believe there should be a place for someone to at least enjoy. The issue is that if they want to share it, the only places we have right now include Twitter, Reddit, Hacker News, and the other means such as Itch and other traditional game distribution platforms. But for small, quick ideas built within an afternoon (yet can play very well / feel very polished due to Opus 5.5 being that good), small entries are often considered "spam." And that's why I made this directory. Yes, I know it gets to the XKCD 927 situation, but I haven't heard of any other platform for these "Claudeslop" games. So here we go!
